claims: The 98th Academy Awards (2026) are held at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles, California.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony takes place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood has hosted the Academy Awards since 2001.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 2026 Academy Awards.
The 2026 Academy Awards are broadcast live on ABC Network.
The 2026 Academy Awards are streamed on Hulu
